message.content:
Here are the material options you can choose from when ordering a custom sculpture:

| Material |
|----------|
| Bronze   |
| Marble   |
| Terracotta |
| Wood     |
| Stone    |

All of these are supported by our `sculpture_create_custom` function. If you'd like to place an order or have more questions, let me know!

So we need to respond with the available materials. According to the function signature, the allowed materials are Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. We should list them.
